summary:
- Find text on any page with Ctrl+F.
- Downloads now open in a compact top-left popup.
- Reopen a recently closed tab from the start page or the tab menu.
- Tab search (Ctrl+Shift+F) highlights matches, and tab rows show a loading state.
- Cycle tabs with Ctrl+PageUp and Ctrl+PageDown, and copy a tab address from its menu.
- Ctrl+Enter opens the typed address in a new tab.
- Each tab keeps its own page zoom across sleep and restart.
- Reset every setting to its default, or open the profile folder from Settings.
- Clear a chosen time range from the History page.
- Screen readers announce tab and workspace changes.
- Higher text contrast and smoother transitions across the sidebar, overlays, and pages.
- F12 opens developer tools in release builds.
- Fixed Google Drive navigation and blob preview frames.
- Fullscreen now covers the taskbar.
- Faster startup and ad blocker updates.
- Hardened navigation and updater integrity checks.
